ResearchProjectDef.label: Dawn of Anima
ResearchProjectDef.description: Begin learning the fundamentals of communing with the anima tree.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Your colony has reached the dawn of a new age. An age of harmony with the anima tree.

The anima tree will provide you with many new resources, and new ways to face your challenges.

As an added bonus, all colonists can now meditate at natural meditation foci, such as the anima tree itself.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Anima Acolyte
ResearchProjectDef.description: Deepen your understanding of the anima tree, and how it can provide tools and weapons to help you thrive.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Your colony has deepened its understanding of the anima tree. New options are available, and a new resource will be required: anima sap. To acquire it, build a sap basin connected to an anima tree, and the basin will siphon a portion of the energy of those meditating at the tree to form anima sap instead of grass.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Anima Shaman
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master your connection to the anima tree, unlocking secrets that are beyond human understanding.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Your colony has reached the apex of anima understanding. Crafts and rituals of great power are now available, and a new resource will be required: anima amber. To acquire it, bring silver to an allied faction and request the location of a Font of Anima. Then, bring anima sap to the Font, and defend it for as long as you can during the crystallization process.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dusk of Void
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stare into the void, tentatively examining the benefits of worshipping the mad void god.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Void Initiate
ResearchProjectDef.description: Step into the void, accepting the gifts of the mad void god.

ResearchProjectDef.description: Immerse yourself in the void, committing yourself to the mad void god.
